parts.name: Checkbox
parts.description: A labelled native checkbox. Use checked/defaultChecked for state; value is only the submitted form value. className styles the label, ref points to the input.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled checked state. Pair with onChange.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state for an uncontrolled checkbox or radio.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native input change handler. Read value or checked from event.currentTarget.

props.name: required
props.description: Requires a non-empty native control value during form validation.

props.name: value
props.description: Current native control value. Pair with onChange for controlled input.

props.name: id
props.description: Native control ID. Generated when omitted; the visible label and supporting text use this association.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
